evidence.excerpt: In this paper, we introduce SWE-CC, a benchmark evaluating code and process compliance in autonomous software engineering.

evidence.label: 描述任务、问题或评测环境
evidence.excerpt: Mature open-source projects publish repository-specific contribution policies, spanning style, git, testing workflows, to ensure code quality and long-term maintainability.

evidence.label: 描述评分指标或评测协议
evidence.excerpt: These results show that functional correctness does not guarantee real-world readiness, highlighting that future software engineering agents must reliably conform to repository governance to enable safe and trustworthy deployment.

evidence.label: 报告基线或多个模型的评测
evidence.excerpt: Our evaluation of four LLMs under two agent scaffolds shows that modern agents suffer from coding compliance issues: although agents produce functionally correct patches, they still violate 43.1 percent of applicable project policies, with nearly half of all violations occurring during intermediate execution steps.
